signals.title: Holders clawing back toward break-even
signals.detail: MVRV has risen 0.62→1.19 over ~30d — the average holder is less underwater than ~30d ago.
signals.framing: Direction of the crowd's PnL, not just today's level.
signals.note: Trend read; don't imply it continues.

signals.title: -74% below its all-time high
signals.detail: Deepest drawdown on record was -92%; it has made new highs after every prior one so far.
signals.framing: Deep drawdowns are the toll — it's paid them before (no recovery promise).
signals.note: It's deep and unrecovered NOW; don't imply it always recovers.

signals.title: 80% of all-time holders are gone — 92% of today's never sold to zero
signals.detail: Of 26,740 wallets that ever held ≥5k SPX, 5,345 remain (80% churned). Yet 92% of CURRENT holders have never once sold to zero — survivorship.
signals.framing: Enormous all-time churn, but the survivors are diamond-handed. The honest "who's still here" read.
signals.note: Right-censoring: recent cohorts read high. "Gone" = fell below the 5k bar.
